title: Fidelity run lock
description: The resolved, closed value that the fidelity compute stage reads as its sole dump-selection input. Emitted by resolve-run-set.py from a run-set manifest; consumed read-only by the coverage/parity/robustness compute tools. Internal to ab-validator (NOT a published ABC schema). See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-fidelity-phase2-resolve-compute-lock.md. The lock is the flake.lock analog: same manifest -> same lock; compute is a pure function of it (given resolve's fail-closed verification).

lock_format.description: Contract identifier + version. Owner: resolve-run-set.py. Compute refuses a lock it does not recognise.

run_set_id.description: Carried through from the manifest for provenance in compute outputs.

manifest.description: Path of the manifest this lock was resolved from (record, not an input).

db_root.description: The AB_DB_ROOT deployment binding this lock was resolved against (provenance). Per-deployment bulk-storage root; the aat_dir paths below are absolute under it.

adapters.description: adapter label -> resolved dump identity. Insertion order is the manifest order; compute selects and orders its own subset.

aat_dir.description: Absolute, fully-resolved AAT directory (AB_DB_ROOT already interpolated at resolve time). Compute globs `${aat_dir}/*.json`.

content_hash.description: sha256:<hex> content hash of the dump's aat/ tree (Move A). Recorded by resolve; when the manifest pins expected.content_hash, resolve verifies this equals it and fails closed on mismatch. Format: see reports/lib/aat_hash.py.

store_path.description: Reserved for Phase 2 Move A: nix store path when the dump is a derivation (store path == content identity).

adapter_version.description: Reserved for Phase 2 Move A: adapter version recorded from the dump descriptor.
